verdict.rationale: The evidence shows data-protection advisory content: a DPDP Act repository, a DPDPA compliance assessment tool, and data-privacy issues within the AI practice. None of it documents security-incident or breach-response work, regulator-facing breach notification, or a dedicated incident-response page. A full-service law firm could plausibly offer this, so the axis applies, but there is no evidence for it.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the firm handles security-incident and breach response, including regulator-facing work, documented on its own pages
